verdict.rationale: First-party docs explicitly state that AI Gateway exposes OpenAI Chat Completions-compatible endpoints. Existing OpenAI client libraries can be pointed at its base URL with no code rewrites, and existing integrations can migrate with a base URL swap. Gateway API keys work anywhere, including local, CI and external servers. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that a base-URL-plus-key swap works unchanged, and documentation of compatibility beyond Chat Completions (e.g. other OpenAI endpoints).
